'''Tympanic''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]]. She was employed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Bandor]] to hunt prisoners in his [[Game Chambers]]. She was armed with a [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]].
